thought.text: Found it — my custom minio image lacks the official `ENTRYPOINT ["minio"]`, so compose's `command: server /data` was executed directly. I'll rebuild with the proper entrypoint:

reasoning_content:
Interesting! The server container's Entrypoint is `/bin/sh -c ...` and Image is b6b98ac31f46 — that's the `nebu-server:latest` image. Wait, the entrypoint looks correct. The error says `exec: "server": executable file not found in $PATH`.

Hmm — this error mentions "server", which is the minio command (`command: server /data ...`). Wait, no. Let me re-read: "Error response from daemon: failed to create task for container: ... exec: "server": executable file not found in $PATH".

Wait, this error is occurring at container creation time. The inspect result shows Entrypoint=[/bin/sh -c ...] Cmd=[] Image=b6b98ac3... — that's the server image. But the failing container might be nebu-minio-1! The minio service uses the image I built myself with `minio server /data`. In my custom minio image, the binary is at `/usr/bin/minio`, and the command is `server /data ...` — the official minio image has its ENTRYPOINT as `/usr/bin/minio`, so `command: server /data` runs the entrypoint minio with the argument `server /data`. In my image I set neither ENTRYPOINT nor CMD! The Dockerfile I made had no ENTRYPOINT, so `command: server ...` was interpreted as CMD `["server", "/data", ...]` — and since there's no entrypoint, it tried to exec "server" directly, but that's not in PATH.

Exactly! The official minio/minio image has ENTRYPOINT ["minio"]. My Dockerfile was missing that. I need to add ENTRYPOINT ["minio"] to the minio image and rebuild.

Note that the entrypoint of the mc image (createbuckets) is set via entrypoint: in compose, so it's fine.

Let me rebuild the minio image with ENTRYPOINT.

action.command:
set -e
cd /workspace/.local-images/minio
cat > Dockerfile <<'EOF'
FROM alpine:3.20
RUN apk add --no-cache curl
COPY minio /usr/bin/minio
RUN chmod +x /usr/bin/minio && minio --version
USER 1000:1000
VOLUME /data
EXPOSE 9000 9001
ENTRYPOINT ["minio"]
EOF
docker build -q -t minio/minio:RELEASE.2025-09-07T16-13-09Z .
